description: BEAN Education permanent milestone commit ledger. One entry per milestone; every approved commit is accounted for exactly once. A milestone is COMPLETE only when its status is COMPLETE and every field is verified — a local commit is not a published commit, a local test is not a CI run. Verified by scripts/branch-health.mjs --gate <milestone-id>.

fieldNotes.finalMainSha: main SHA after the milestone merge, verified via git ls-remote.
fieldNotes.syncStatus: PENDING | SYNCHRONIZED — feature branch vs main after the merge (repo policy: merged branches must not drift).
